title: oist/LuscombeU_Selenoproteins_Pipeline pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Genome name must be provided and may contain only letters, digits, '_', '.' and '-'

fasta.errorMessage: Genome FASTA must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fa', '.fasta' or '.fna', optionally followed by '.gz'

domain.errorMessage: Domain must be one of 'eukaryota', 'bacteria' or 'archaea'

profiles.errorMessage: Profiles must be a comma-separated list of Selenoprofiles profile or profile-set names, without spaces

annotation.errorMessage: Annotation must be a GFF3 file with extension '.gff' or '.gff3', optionally followed by '.gz'

transcripts.errorMessage: Transcripts must be a FASTA file with extension '.fa', '.fasta' or '.fna', optionally followed by '.gz'
